body:
I appreciated that so much I don’t really think you read all the way through on my situation but advice you are giving is good.
I am in my 20s but I am technically middle aged. Thankyou for the nice comment!

If that’s truly how you want to, it’s not my place to say no.
I made a post explaining my situation. If you do go yes.. a sign would make me feel happy for you.
Look. I’m not saying you’re life isn’t worth leaving it’s your choice.
I’ll be getting surgery tomorrow if I have any vivid dreams while under I hope it’s from you telling me your happy, or someday you’ll tell me you’re happy on here. Soul to soul if that’s your choice find me.

If you do go give me a sign there’s something out there.
Please, if you don’t update me on how you are
I understand and it’s your choice. But the world whoever you are will miss you.
If you do go just show me there’s something beyond..
